description: Read one existing expense from the authenticated user's ExpenseBot spreadsheet. Supply the exact expenseId returned by search_expenses (Receipt ID in Column Q), or the user's specified rowNumber. Never invent an identifier. Returns sheetName, rowNumber, headers, values, labeled fields and, when available, reviewExpenseUrl. This tool does not edit, submit, delete, share, or scan anything.

expenseId.description: Exact full ExpenseBot Receipt ID from Column Q

name: get_expense_by_id

rowNumber.description: Resolved sheet row for the expense.
